title: Psychedelic Onion Shack
description: A surreal night scene features a purple wooden shack with onion-like decorations and a large anthropomorphic purple onion character with a yellow bow, bowtie and angry expression holding a banana. The shack sits beside a glowing blue pond with a swirling green onion-shaped mountain in the background, under a purple starry sky with yellow lightning and a floating monkey head with X eyes dripping purple liquid.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic night landscape with a glowing blue pond and swirling green patterned onion mountain in the distance. In the foreground a small purple wooden shack covered in onion motifs sits on a green field with a black winding path. A large anthropomorphic purple onion with angry eyes, yellow leaves, green bowtie and holding a banana stands on the roof. Above everything floats a large white monkey head with X-shaped eyes, wide purple dripping grin, and yellow lightning bolts against a purple starry sky with swirling patterns.
